text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Friday it was offering special, low fares for flights in the upcoming year. Fares for selected destinations are to range from $29 each way to $179 each way.
The fares will be available through January 23, 1997, for travel from January 1, 1997 through June 2, 1997.
The fares do not include airport-assessed passenger facility charges of up to $12 roundtrip.
Tickets must be purchased within one day of making reservations and at least one day before departure, the company said. The tickets are non-refundable, it said.

Some of the cheapest fares includes flights between Albuquerque, N.M., and Phoenix, Ariz., for $29 each way, and between Reno, Nev., and Oakland, Calif. At the high end, the company is offering fares of $179 each way between Los Angeles and Tampa, Fla., New Orleans and Portland, Ore., and between Columbus, Ohio, and Reno, Nev.
